Ideogram 4 LoRA dataset
	

This directory is generated from weekend_training/manifest.jsonl without
modifying the original Qwen-Image data.
Output paths match the Hugging Face layout in
sungmine/korean_atomic_infographic. In particular, atomic_text_new images
are addressed through its complete 10,000-image range folders:
000001-010000, 010001-020000, and 020001-030000. The incomplete legacy
flat folder is not referenced.
